title: LOGO_BASE hardcoded to legacy portal URL `https://decades.powerappsportals.com/` â€” violates loadConfig mandate
detail: Line 25: `const LOGO_BASE = 'https://decades.powerappsportals.com/';` â€” this points at the LEGACY non-SPA portal, not dmms1/dcfg/holding. Per CLAUDE.md 'Config: dcfg_configs table read at boot via loadConfig() â€” no hardcoded URLs', every cross-environment URL should be pulled from dcfg_configs. The customer header logo src concatenates this base with LOGO_MAP[customer.dcfg_name] (line 81). On Prod today: customer avatars load from a different portal's asset library, which (a) makes Prod depend on a legacy portal being up, (b) may show stale/wrong logos if the legacy portal was updated independently, and (c) fails if the operator removes the legacy portal later in the decommission plan.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:25 `const LOGO_BASE = 'https://decades.powerappsportals.com/';`, line 81 img src=LOGO_BASE + filename.
recommendedFix: Short-term: add a `dcfg_sp_logo_base_url` key to dcfg_configs and read via `getEnvVar('dcfg_sp_logo_base_url')` with a fallback to the current hardcoded URL. Long-term: upload customer logos to a DCFG_Assets SharePoint library or the customer record itself, stop cross-portal referencing entirely. File this as infra follow-up after Phase 6.

title: CustomerDetail hardcodes `isManager={true}` / `isAdmin={true}` to sub-tabs â€” every user sees admin actions
detail: Lines 130, 132, 134, 135 pass hardcoded `isManager={true}` and `isAdmin={true}` to OverviewTab, MsasTab, OnboardingTab, and ProgramsTab. Line 32 destructures `isAdmin, isManager` from usePortalUser but those real values are IGNORED in favor of the hardcoded true. Downstream, those flags gate the `+ New MSA`, `+ New Onboarding Case`, `Mark Complete`, and `+ New Program` buttons â€” so every authenticated user sees and can click those admin-only actions. Same bug class as CR-2026-04-09-0248 (ContractDetail void/decline) but implemented by literal prop override. External customer testers will be able to create MSAs and programs.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:32 destructures isAdmin, isManager. Lines 130-135 pass `isManager={true}` / `isAdmin={true}` literally. Lines 228, 433, 443, 463, 506 in sub-components use the prop to render admin controls.
recommendedFix: Replace the hardcoded prop values with the real function calls: `isManager={isManager()}`, `isAdmin={isAdmin()}`. Same pattern as OnboardingDetail.jsx:619 which calls `isManager={isManager()}` correctly. Then smoke-test with a non-admin portal user to confirm the New MSA / New Onboarding / New Program buttons disappear from the customer detail tabs.

title: OverviewTab counts use $count=true but reads value?.length â€” returns top-page count, not total
detail: Lines 145-149: two apiGet calls with `$count=true` but the callback reads `msaRes?.value?.length` and `locRes?.value?.length` rather than `@odata.count`. Dataverse returns the total count as `@odata.count` when $count=true is present; `.value` is still the first page of up-to-5000 records. For customers with <5000 MSAs/locations the current code happens to work because value.length == total. For a customer with more, the KPI cards will silently show the wrong number. Low impact today but a latent data bug.
recommendedFix: Either drop `$count=true` (it's unnecessary if you're reading value.length) or read `msaRes?.['@odata.count']` to use the true total. Prefer dropping $count=true â€” it's not supported by Power Pages Web API consistently and value.length is fine at current scale.

title: OverviewTab nested apiGet inside .then has no error handler â€” unhandled promise rejection on failure
detail: Line 152-153: after the Promise.all resolves, the code makes ANOTHER apiGet inside the .then handler for contracts counts. There's no .catch on that inner promise â€” if it rejects, an unhandled-promise-rejection fires, caught only by the global error buffer. Line 156 also has no outer .catch on the Promise.all chain, so either root fetch failing silently skips all counts.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:144-156 â€” Promise.all with no outer catch, inner apiGet with no catch.
recommendedFix: Add `.catch(() => {})` or explicit error logging to both the outer Promise.all and the inner apiGet. Better: wrap the whole effect body in try/catch and set error state the user can see.

title: LocationsMapTab injects Leaflet CSS/JS from CDN at runtime â€” hardcoded unpkg.com URLs
detail: Lines 613, 618: `css.href = 'https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css';` and `js.src = 'https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js';`. MapView.jsx (line 10-11) imports leaflet as an npm dependency and bundles it, but CustomerDetail duplicates that functionality by injecting from CDN. Two runtime copies of Leaflet cause memory waste and potential version drift. Cat 11 handoff cleanliness.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:613, 618 â€” CDN injection. MapView.jsx:10-11 â€” bundled import.
recommendedFix: Replace the CDN injection with `import L from 'leaflet'; import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css';` at the top of CustomerDetail (same as MapView). Remove the runtime script/link injection entirely.
